page_text_ocr_zh:
清风徐徐，明月高挂，皇宫内一派歌舞升平，皇帝正兴致勃勃地喝酒赏月。
“咚咚咚——”一阵急促的景阳钟声打破了夜晚的平静。只见丞相寇准一脸焦急地奔进殿来：“万岁，西夏番王造反了！大军已连续攻占咱们三座城池！照此下去，京城可就危险了呀！
“什么？”皇帝大惊失色，忙召兵部尚书王强进宫商议对策。
page_text_en:
The breeze was gentle, the bright moon hung high, and within the palace, there was a scene of music and dancing. The emperor was happily drinking wine and admiring the moon.
"Dong dong dong—" A sudden, urgent Jingyang bell shattered the night's peace. Chancellor Kou Zhun rushed into the hall, his face full of anxiety: "Your Majesty, the Western Xia chieftain has rebelled! Their army has already captured three of our cities in succession! If this continues, the capital will be in grave danger!"
"What?" The emperor was shocked and alarmed, quickly summoning Minister of War Wang Qiang to the palace to discuss countermeasures.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了皇宫内歌舞升平的夜晚被急促钟声打破，丞相寇准紧急禀报西夏造反、三城失守，皇帝震惊并召兵部尚书商议对策。

page_text_ocr_zh:
王强听闻前方军情，轻描淡写地说：‘西夏小国前来挑衅，只不过是因为国库空虚，想趁机勒索些钱财罢了。’
寇准却表示反对，说吞并中原才是他们真正的野心！
皇帝听取了寇准的分析，决定发兵征讨，只是一时半会儿不知道谁能挂帅出征。
‘挂帅之人非杨家将不可！’寇准脱口而出。
‘杨家将隐居已经二十多年了，怎能担此大任？’王强急忙否定，‘我儿子王伦文武双全，可以率领大军出征。’
‘这……’皇帝面露难色。他思量了一番，决定校场比武，胜者为帅。
page_text_en:
Wang Qiang, upon hearing the news from the front, said lightly, 'The small Western Xia state is provoking us, but it's only because the national treasury is empty and they want to extort some money.'
Kou Zun, however, opposed this, saying that annexing the Central Plains was their true ambition!
The emperor, after listening to Kou Zun's analysis, decided to send troops to fight, but was unsure who could be appointed as the commander.
'Only the Yang family generals can lead the army!' Kou Zun blurted out.
'The Yang family has been in seclusion for over twenty years; how can they take on such a responsibility?' Wang Qiang quickly objected, 'My son Wang Lun is skilled in both literature and martial arts and can lead the army.'
'This...' The emperor looked troubled. After thinking for a while, he decided to hold a martial contest in the training ground, and the winner would be the commander.
summary_zh: 皇帝在听取寇准和王强关于西夏挑衅的分析后，因无人可担帅职而陷入困境，最终决定通过校场比武选拔统帅。

page_text_ocr_zh:
王强气呼呼地回到家，把比武夺帅的消息告诉了儿子王伦。
王伦非常自信地说：“爹爹不用担心，孩儿的刀法和箭法都是天下第一，这帅印肯定是我的囊中之物！
“好！有志气！”王强拍手称赞，“等你夺得帅印，掌握了兵权，我们再与西夏番王里应外合，这大宋江山就是我们的了。”
page_text_en:
Wang Qiang returned home in a huff and told his son Wang Lun about the news of the martial contest to seize the帅印 (command seal).
Wang Lun said confidently, "Father, don't worry. My swordsmanship and archery are the best in the world. This command seal is surely mine!"
"Well done! How ambitious!" Wang Qiang clapped his hands in praise. "Once you obtain the command seal and take control of the army, we'll join forces with the Western Xia king from within and without. Then, the江山 (realm) of the Song Dynasty will be ours!"
summary_zh: 王强回家后向儿子王伦透露了比武夺帅的消息，王伦自信满满地表示自己必胜，王强则拍手称赞，并密谋与西夏番王里应外合，夺取大宋江山。

page_text_ocr_zh:
杨家虽然远离京城、
隐居山林，但一直心系
国家安危。收到边关
告急的消息，佘太君十
分忧虑，便与孙媳穆桂
英和孙子杨宗保商量，
派曾孙杨文广和曾孙女
杨金花去京城打探军情。
page_text_en: Although the Yang family lived far from the capital, secluded in the mountains, they always cared about the nation's safety. Upon receiving urgent news from the frontier, Lady Sha was deeply worried. She discussed the matter with her granddaughter-in-law Mu Guiying and grandson Yang Zongbao, and decided to send her great-grandson Yang Wenguang and great-granddaughter Yang Jinhua to the capital to investigate the military situation.
summary_zh: 杨家虽隐居山林，但心系国家安危。佘太君得知边关告急，与穆桂英、杨宗保商议后，派杨文广和杨金花前往京城探查军情。

page_text_ocr_zh:
两个孩子年纪还小，又是第一次独自进京，
穆桂英有点放心不下，可是家里没有更合适的人选，
只能这样安排。望着马蹄远去，荡起飞尘，穆桂英的
眼里充满了牵挂。
page_text_en:
The two children are still young, and it's their first time going to the capital alone.
Mu Guiying is a bit worried, but there's no one more suitable at home,
so she can only make this arrangement. Watching the horses gallop away, kicking up dust, Mu Guiying's
eyes are filled with concern.
summary_zh: 穆桂英因两个孩子年纪小且首次独自进京而放心不下，但因无更合适人选，只得安排他们前往京城探查军情，望着他们远去的背影，她眼中满是牵挂。

page_text_ocr_zh: 杨文广和杨金花快马加鞭地赶到京城，只见东京城内热闹非凡。他俩心血来潮，想去看一看杨家从前的府邸——天波府。可是，现在的天波府已经变成了兵部尚书王强的家。他们在天波府门口转悠的时候，被盛气凌人的门卫羞辱了一番。杨文广看不惯门卫仗势欺人的嘴脸，一拳将他打倒在地。
page_text_en: Yang Wenguang and Yang Jinhua galloped to the capital city, where they saw the city of Dongjing bustling with activity. Impulsively, they wanted to visit their family's former residence—the Tianbo Mansion. However, the Tianbo Mansion had now become the home of Wang Qiang, the Minister of War. While loitering at the gate of the Tianbo Mansion, they were insulted by an arrogant gatekeeper. Yang Wenguang, unable to bear the gatekeeper's arrogant and bullying demeanor, punched him to the ground.
summary_zh: 杨文广和杨金花抵达京城，想探访杨家旧宅天波府，却发现它已被兵部尚书王强占据，二人在门口遭门卫羞辱，杨文广愤而将其打倒。

page_text_ocr_zh: 从门卫口中，他们得知校场正在比武，胜出的人便能挂帅出征。于是，姐弟俩匆匆赶往校场，打算参加比武，争夺帅印。
page_text_en: From the gate guards, they learned that a martial contest was underway at the training ground, and the winner would be appointed commander for the campaign. Thus, the sister and brother hurried to the training ground, intending to join the contest and compete for the commander's seal.
summary_zh: 杨文广和杨金花从门卫处得知校场正在举行比武选帅，便匆匆赶往校场，准备参加比武争夺帅印。

page_text_ocr_zh: 校场上，王伦凭借出色的刀法和箭法，赢了所有前来挑战的人。皇帝十分满意，拿出帅印，准备交给王伦。突然传来一声呐喊：“杨文广来也——”话音刚落，杨文广和杨金花就冲到了皇帝面前，恳请与王伦比试。王强见横空杀出两个无名小孩，马上叫人轰他们出去。杨金花问皇帝：“万岁召集天下能人校场比武，不就是为了选出挂帅的最佳人选吗？我们姐弟虽然年幼，但也有一身武艺，也想为国杀敌，为什么不让我们比试呢？”
page_text_en: On the training ground, Wang Lun,凭借 his outstanding swordsmanship and archery, defeated all challengers. The emperor was very pleased and took out the帅印, ready to hand it to Wang Lun. Suddenly, a shout rang out: "Yang Wenguang is here!" As soon as the words were spoken, Yang Wenguang and Yang Jinhua rushed before the emperor, pleading to compete against Wang Lun. Wang Qiang, seeing two unknown children suddenly appear, immediately ordered them to be driven out. Yang Jinhua asked the emperor: "Your Majesty, you gathered talented people from across the land for this martial contest. Isn't it precisely to select the best candidate to lead the army? Though we siblings are young, we also possess martial skills and wish to fight for our country. Why won't you let us compete?"
summary_zh: 在比武选帅的校场上，王伦获胜即将获得帅印，杨文广和杨金花突然闯入请求比试，王强欲驱赶他们，杨金花向皇帝请求公平比武的机会。

page_text_ocr_zh:
寇准见这两个孩子英气逼人，举止谈吐不卑不亢，立刻建议皇帝给他们一个机会。皇帝答应了。杨金花举起弓箭，一箭射穿金钱，又一箭射断红线，干净利落。
“看我的！”杨文广接过弓箭，对准天上的大雁，正要放箭，却听“啪”的一声——弓居然折断了。
page_text_en:
Kou Zun saw these two children full of heroic spirit, their manners and speech neither humble nor arrogant, and immediately suggested to the emperor that they be given a chance. The emperor agreed. Yang Jinhua raised her bow and arrow, shooting one arrow through the gold coin and another severing the red thread, cleanly and skillfully.
"Watch this!" Yang Wenguang took the bow and arrow, aimed at the geese in the sky, and was about to release the arrow when he heard a "snap"—the bow suddenly broke.
summary_zh: 在比武选帅的校场上，寇准为杨金花和杨文广争取了比武机会。杨金花连射两箭，精准命中目标；杨文广准备射雁时，弓弦突然断裂。

page_text_ocr_zh:
杨文广很懊恼。
王强一看，计上心来，对皇帝建议道：
“天波府里有一把重五百斤的铁胎弓，不如拿来给他试一试。”
皇帝欣然答应。
铁胎弓送来，杨文广轻轻松松拿起弓
一看，上面刻着“金刀杨”三个苍劲大字，
这不正是传说中杨家祖传四代的宝弓
吗？！杨文广兴奋地用力拉满弓，“嗖”地
射下一双大雁。
page_text_en:
Yang Wenguang felt very frustrated.
Wang Qiang, seeing this, had an idea and suggested to the emperor: 
"There is a 500-jin iron bow in Tianbo Mansion. Why not bring it for him to try?"
The emperor gladly agreed.
The iron bow was brought. Yang Wenguang picked it up effortlessly.
He looked at it and saw the three bold characters "Jindao Yang" engraved on it.
Wasn't this exactly the legendary treasure bow passed down through four generations of the Yang family?!
Yang Wenguang excitedly drew the bow fully and, with a "whoosh," shot down a pair of geese.
summary_zh: 在比武选帅的校场上，杨文广因弓弦断裂而懊恼，王强建议让他试用天波府的祖传宝弓，杨文广轻松拿起宝弓并成功射下两只大雁。

page_text_ocr_zh:
围观的人都惊呆了，寇准连忙上前询问：“你们叫什么名字？”
姐弟俩报上姓名，原来是杨家的后人，寇准喜出望外。
寇准立即向皇帝推荐姐弟二人挂帅。
王伦不服气，皇帝便命令他与杨文广继续比试刀法，校场比武，生死无罪。王伦出尽银招，想置杨文广于死地。谁料经过几番激烈的争斗，他反而被杨文广一刀劈死。
page_text_en:
The onlookers were stunned. Kou Zun hurriedly approached and asked, "What are your names?"
The brother and sister reported their names. They were descendants of the Yang family, and Kou Zun was overjoyed.
Kou Zun immediately recommended the two to the emperor to lead the army.
Wang Lun was不服气 (unwilling to accept defeat), so the emperor ordered him to continue the sword-fighting contest with Yang Wenguang. The match took place in the training ground, with no penalty for death. Wang Lun used every trick he could think of, trying to kill Yang Wenguang. But after several fierce rounds of combat, he was instead killed by Yang Wenguang with a single slash.
summary_zh: 在比武选帅的校场上，杨文广与王伦进行刀法对决，王伦虽使尽招数欲置其于死地，但最终被杨文广一刀劈死，围观者震惊，寇准随即向皇帝推荐杨家姐弟挂帅。

page_text_ocr_zh:
皇帝按照约定，将帅印封给了杨文广。但他见杨文广年纪轻轻，很是担忧：“他这么小，能带兵吗？”
寇准及时献策：“他的母亲穆桂英当年统兵，大破敌军的天门七十二阵，杀得敌人溃不成军。如果由她挂帅，必定可以击退西夏敌军！”
皇帝一听非常高兴，立刻封穆桂英为主帅，杨宗保为副帅，杨金花和杨文广姐弟二人先回家报喜。
page_text_en:
The emperor, according to the agreement, bestowed the military seal upon Yang Wenguang. But seeing that Yang Wenguang was so young, he worried: "How can such a young man lead troops?"
Kou Zun promptly offered a suggestion: "His mother, Mu Guiying, once commanded troops and broke the enemy's Tianmen 72 formations, routing them completely. If she were to lead the army, we would surely defeat the Western Xia forces!"
The emperor, upon hearing this, was very pleased. He immediately appointed Mu Guiying as the main commander, Yang Zongbao as the deputy commander, and sent Yang Jinhua and Yang Wenguang, brother and sister, home to deliver the good news.
summary_zh: 皇帝将帅印授予杨文广，但因他年幼而担忧，寇准建议由其母穆桂英挂帅，皇帝采纳并任命穆桂英为主帅、杨宗保为副帅，命杨金花和杨文广回家报喜。

page_text_ocr_zh:
杨金花和杨文广兴高采烈地带着帅印回到家，一进门，杨金花就滔滔不绝地讲起了在京城的经历。

佘太君见到帅印，激动得老泪纵横：“二十年前我交出帅印，全家隐居山林。如今帅印又交回杨家，可我的夫君和儿子却早已为国捐躯了！”感慨许久，佘太君擦干眼泪，对杨金花和杨文广说：“国难当头，你俩快收拾行装，随你们母亲出征去吧！”，
page_text_en:
Yang Jinhua and Yang Wenguang returned home happily with the military seal. As soon as they entered the door, Yang Jinhua began to talk excitedly about their experiences in the capital.

Grandmother Sha, seeing the military seal, was overwhelmed with emotion and shed tears: "Twenty years ago, I handed over the seal, and our family retreated to live in the mountains. Now the seal has returned to the Yang family, but my husband and son have long since sacrificed their lives for the country!" After a long moment of reflection, Grandmother Sha wiped her tears and said to Yang Jinhua and Yang Wenguang, "The nation is in crisis. You two must quickly pack your belongings and join your mother on the campaign!"
summary_zh: 杨金花和杨文广带着帅印回家，向佘太君讲述京城经历，佘太君激动落泪，感慨杨家先辈牺牲，并命令姐弟俩收拾行装，随母亲穆桂英出征。

page_text_ocr_zh:
穆桂英却有几分不情愿：“皇帝昏庸无道，宠信奸臣，早已让我心寒。我可不愿为这样的天子领兵出战。”
“退敌保国不是为了荣华恩宠，而是为了百姓安宁。你要是不愿意出征，那就我去！”佘太君说完，抱起帅印就要出门。
穆桂英心疼太君年迈，连忙追上去说：“老太君说得有道理，我即刻整顿三军，不击退西夏敌军，誓不罢休！”
page_text_en:
Mu Guiying was somewhat reluctant: "The emperor is corrupt and favors villains; he has long made my heart cold. I do not wish to lead troops for such a ruler." 
"Repelling the enemy and protecting the country is not for glory or favor, but for the peace of the people. If you are unwilling to lead the campaign, then I will!" said Shu Taijun, picking up the military seal and preparing to leave. 
Mu Guiying, concerned for her elderly grandmother, hurried after her and said, "Grandmother, you are right. I will immediately organize the army and will not rest until we drive back the Western Xia forces!"
summary_zh: 穆桂英起初不愿为昏君出征，佘太君以百姓安宁为重，抱起帅印欲亲自出征，穆桂英深受感动，决定立即整顿三军，誓要击退敌军。

page_text_ocr_zh:
校场上金鼓齐鸣，号角震天。迎风飘扬的“穆”字大旗下，穆桂英挥动令旗，号令道：“发兵！”
“擒贼灭寇，舍身保国！”
将士们的呐喊声在军阵中层层回荡开来，久久盘旋在高远辽阔的天地间。
page_text_en:
On the training ground, drums and gongs resounded, and bugles echoed through the sky. Under the fluttering banner with the character 'Mu', Mu Guiying waved her command flag and ordered, "March out!"
"Capture the enemies, destroy the bandits, and sacrifice ourselves to protect the country!"
The soldiers' shouts echoed through the ranks, reverberating and lingering in the vast and lofty sky.
summary_zh: 穆桂英在军阵中挥动令旗，下令出征，将士们高呼口号，士气高昂。
画面描绘了穆桂英率领将士们骑马出征的场景，队伍中高举写有“穆”字的旗帜，士气高昂，正奔赴战场。
